column1: # Android app -> Linux version installed on Fedora by s6-restore (and shown in the app).
# Columns (tab separated): android package (exact, or prefix ending in *) | Linux app name | method | target | note
#   preinstalled  part of Fedora KDE already; target = rpm package name (installed with dnf if missing)
#   dnf           Fedora package; target = package name
#   flatpak       Flathub app id (installed per user)
#   rpm-github    owner/repo|asset file name with {ver}|known-good tag: newest release asset (falls back to the known-good tag), installed with dnf
# Only apps with a working ARM64 (aarch64) Linux version are listed. Unknown apps simply stay Android apps.
